name: Engine on short mid long cases
command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@raspberrypi.tailf63b31.ts.net 'cd ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/asm && S2=$(echo ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--google--gemma-3-270m-it-qat-q4_0-unquantized/snapshots/*/model.safetensors) && for C in short mid long; do timeout 200 ./core $S2 ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/vocab.bin 2 f ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/bpe.bin < /tmp/c_$C.txt > /tmp/e_$C.log 2>&1; echo "== $C (exit $?)"; awk "/^tpl:/{f=1} f" /tmp/e_$C.log | tail -n +2 | head -3 | cut -c1-55; done'
